g.text: A Logix connect is a symbol-table browse, and the pool is what makes two dataports share one.
process-wide singleton · one client per controller, reference-counted
released back to zero → disconnect + dispose
record equality is the "same connection" test
_connected is the only connection bookkeeping here
libplctag opens no socket until a handle is first
read, so the browse is what a connect establishes
— and the proof the controller answers CIP.
frees every handle, drops the symbol table. Reversible.
terminal. A handle left to its finalizer fail-fasts
